question_record.context: During a security incident where a known credential theft tool named 'mimikatz.exe' was executed on the host `vnevado-win10v`, it was detected through the command line indicating attempts to dump users' credentials and passwords. Multiple dual-purpose tools were then dropped on the same device, and subsequently, 'Kekeo' malware was identified during a lateral movement attempt.
question_record.question: Can you provide the Security Identifier (SID) of the account involved in the lateral movement detection of 'Kekeo' malware?
solution: A known credential theft tool named `mimikatz.exe` was executed.
Multiple dual-purpose tools including `rubeus.exe` were dropped on the device, which might be used for credential theft, privilege escalation, and lateral movement.
The 'Kekeo' malware was detected on the device, indicating an attempt for lateral movement, involving the account with SID `S-1-5-21-1540151660-3530000288-105586595-1517`.

89.name: Malicious credential theft tool execution detected
89.description:
A known credential theft tool execution command line was detected.
Either the process itself or its command line indicated an intent to dump users' credentials, keys, plain-text passwords and more.

62.name: Multiple dual-purpose tools were dropped
62.description:
Multiple known public tools, which could also be used for malicious reasons were dropped on this device.
Attackers might download or copy multiple dual-purpose tools to the target device to perform various attack stages including, credential theft, privilege escalation, and lateral movement.

110.name: 'Kekeo' malware was detected during lateral movement
110.description: 'Kekeo' malware was detected on this device. An attacker might be attempting to move laterally to this device from another device on the network.

interpretation.scope: official graph witness, not a proof of causality, actor identity or autonomous planning

steps.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT o.AlertId, o.AlertTitle, o.ObservedAt, o.EntityIndex,
       o.GraphValue AS value, o.RawComponents, o.Roles, o.SourceRowHash,
       i.GraphValue AS matched_input
FROM LTMInputEvidence i
JOIN LTMEntityEvidence o ON o.SourceRowHash = i.SourceRowHash
WHERE i.AlertTitle = %s
  AND i.Concept = 'Account_AAD_ID' AND o.Concept = 'Command_File_Mention'
  AND i.GraphValue IN (%s)
ORDER BY o.AlertId, o.SourceRowHash, o.EntityIndex, o.GraphValue, i.GraphValue
LIMIT 501
